content.short: D2 Finance runs actively traded quantitative vaults with defined risk mandates.
content.description: D2 Finance is a multi-strategy fund running derivatives strategies as tokenized on-chain vaults, actively traded and not passively allocated. The team came from quantitative derivatives desks at APAC institutions, with five years there and a further two years trading in crypto. Vaults share liquidity across strategies and every position is auditable on-chain. Deployments now include Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain.
content.meta: Quant strategies run as actively traded onchain vaults, with every position visible in real time.
